description: EPS 8-pin +12V CPU power input. Dedicated 12V feed to the CPU VRM, separate from the 24-pin ATX_12V. Some boards will not boot without it.

typical_voltage_v.notes: Same as ATX_12V; both come from the PSU 12V rail.

cable_note: The EPS 8-pin and PCIe 8-pin connectors are keyed differently but a mis-keyed cable can be forced. Verify the cable is the CPU EPS cable, not a PCIe cable, before powering.
